main.content:
The BITwiki Epistemic Tiers framework defines four confidence levels for knowledge claims:

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Level
! Meaning
! Use
|-
| '''Hypothetical'''
| Speculative, early-stage
| Exploratory ideas, conjectures
|-
| '''Emerging'''
| Preliminary, developing
| New findings, single sources
|-
| '''Established'''
| Multiple sources, consistent
| Well-supported claims
|-
| '''Archived'''
| Historical, superseded
| Old versions, preserved for reference
|}

[[Category:BITwiki Epistemic Tiers]]
